name: cockpit
description: Live panes and bands for session awareness: agents-progress, cockpit-pane, cache-keeper, context-health, filetree, next-steps, usage-limits

agentsProgress.title: agents-progress
agentsProgress.description: Live subagent panel, a running-agents band and a main-session todo/task progress band above the prompt

cacheKeeper.title: cache-keeper
cacheKeeper.description: Cache countdown band, /keepwarm pings and a cold-send guard with cost estimate

cockpitPane.title: cockpit-pane
cockpitPane.description: Docked pane repeating the context, usage-limit and progress bands, so they stay visible when a desktop dialog hides the prompt area; /cockpit reopens it

contextHealth.title: context-health
contextHealth.description: Context fill band with turn, speed, cost, dismiss, warnings, /ctx-handoff and /autohandoff

filetree.title: filetree
filetree.description: File tree pane with git status and highlights for files Claude reads and writes

nextSteps.title: next-steps
nextSteps.description: Suggests three next prompts after each turn

usageLimits.title: usage-limits
usageLimits.description: Always-visible band with session (5h) and weekly (7d) limit usage, reset countdown, pace and a toast at 90%
